figures.finding: Botswana has no film fund yet: the Ministry of Sport and Arts commissions films directly (its District Film Development and Mentorship Programme commissioned eight full-length films for P2.9 million) and earmarked P23 million for 2026/27 to buy content from 34 producers; the National Arts Council announced in October 2026 that it plans a creative industry fund.

sources.said: he said the Cinematography Act, intended to modernise the creative sector, would be presented during the current sitting of Parliament. Upon its enactment, he said government would establish the National Film Commission to foster a local filming culture. … The minister said the District Film Development and Mentorship Programme had commissioned eight full-length films at a total cost of P2.9 million. … The minister said P23 million had been earmarked for acquisition of content from 34 producers.
The National Arts Council of Botswana (NAC) has unveiled plans to establish a creative industry fund and an investment arm to support sustainable growth in the sector.
